svg.aria-label: Orbica: Space encyclopedia + real-time orbital tracking. Rockets, satellites and launches since 1957, with live 3D orbital tracking and real-time SGP4 propagation over WebSockets. Built with Next.js, React Three Fiber, Go, PostgreSQL.
